text:
Alyssa M (Marketing): Hey team — we're finalizing webinar slides and need a small, reproducible bench sweep to cite for the 'cost vs latency' slide. Can runtime run a quick sweep across 3 model variants (base / quant / distill) at seq-lens 128/512/2048 and share the exact commands + raw CSVs? prefer p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec numbers.
Matt R (Eng Runtime): Sure. Quick Qs: which GPU should we target (A100 vs T4)? include streaming latency? and do you need cold-start numbers?
Alyssa M (Marketing): Prefer A100. Streaming latency would be great but only if it's a 1–2 hour add. Cold-start not necessary for the slide — we just want steady-state numbers and the seed to reproduce.
Jess K (Eng Runtime): Ok we'll run steady-state. We'll include p50/p95, mean throughput (tokens/sec), and GPU util. Also include the exact model hashes + quant config.
Carmen L (Data & Analytics): Please capture token-cost estimate in USD using our cost model (instance-hour + token pricing) so we can show per-1k-token cost.
Matt R (Eng Runtime): Got it. Plan: run three variants x three seqs x 3 replicates. I'll script it and post the command. ETA 6 hours. Assigning to @Jess K to run.
Jess K (Eng Runtime): Starting now. Command I'm running:
```bash
./bench-runner --model=MODEL_PATH --device=a100 --seq-len=512 --batch-size=8 --warmup=60 --duration=300 --quant-config=configs/q8.yaml --seed=42 --metrics=p50,p95,throughput,gpu_util --output=out/$(date +%s)-MODEL_SEQ.csv
```
Jess K (Eng Runtime): Note: we're enabling KV cache prefill for the 2048 runs to avoid OOMs; will mark that in metadata.
bench-bot: Job queued: bench-runner job id 789012 started by Jess K. Logs: https://ci.internal/bench/789012
Matt R (Eng Runtime): For reproducibility: we'll save conda env + git rev-parse HEAD + cu libs. I'll add a small README in the output zip.
Jess K (Eng Runtime): Quick smoke results (first replicate):
- base @128: p50=12ms, p95=38ms, throughput=420 tok/s, gpu_util=72%
- quant @128: p50=9ms, p95=29ms, throughput=560 tok/s, gpu_util=64%
- distill @128: p50=7ms, p95=22ms, throughput=680 tok/s, gpu_util=58%
Jess K (Eng Runtime): Full CSVs uploading to s3://redwood-bench/webinar/1812345678/ now. Link: s3://redwood-bench/webinar/1812345678/outputs.zip
Alyssa M (Marketing): Amazing — can you also drop a 1-paragraph blurb (2–3 sentences) explaining methodology we can paste on the slide? e.g., steady-state runs on A100, 3 replicates, seed 42, KV prefill for long sequences.
Matt R (Eng Runtime): I'll draft the blurb and include the exact command and config paths.
Carmen L (Data & Analytics): I'll compute the USD per-1k-token numbers from the CSVs and post them here when ready.
Jess K (Eng Runtime): All outputs and README are uploaded. I've included a small note about caching behavior and which runs used KV prefill.
Alyssa M (Marketing): Perfect — once Carmen posts cost numbers, we'll lock the slide and route final assets to sales (handbook@redwood). Please add any caveats in the README — we need this to be defensible in Q&A. :rocket:
Matt R (Eng Runtime): Will do. @Jess K please leave the benchmark job id in the README for traceability.
Jess K (Eng Runtime): Done. job id 789012 in README.
Carmen L (Data & Analytics): Cost calc quick numbers: base @128 = $0.0048 per 1k tokens, quant @128 = $0.0036 per 1k tokens, distill @128 = $0.0029 per 1k tokens. I'll attach the calc sheet. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Alyssa M (Marketing): Thank you all — this is exactly what we needed. Will ping if legal wants additional detail. :thumbsup:
